context: The skill should convert a simple Optional presence-check/value-read into a direct Optional boundary without introducing null or fake collections.

checklist.name: Uses Optional map/orElse boundary
checklist.description: Replaces isPresent() plus get() with user.map(User::displayName).orElse("Anonymous") or a directly equivalent Optional expression.

checklist.name: No null workaround
checklist.description: Does not introduce orElse(null), null assignment, or value != null branching.

checklist.name: No fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not convert the single Optional into a stream, list, loop, or collection.

checklist.name: Behavior preserved
checklist.description: Preserves the fallback string "Anonymous" and the present-value displayName behavior.
